acceptance.advantage: More paired task successes than conventional with zero paired losses, or equal successes and strictly lower total logical work; ties do not demonstrate advantage
acceptance.adverse_success: Low energy returns/lands safely; stale sensor or lost agent produces latched SAFE veto, no post-veto sends/heartbeats, observed disarm; remains a mission-completion failure
acceptance.mission_success: Externally observed target plus RGB marker, observed return home, disarmed, reserve >=40, no safety violation
acceptance.promotion: No automatic ECHO-5, S6, real flight, HIL or hardware green; physical and software evidence never substitute for one another
acceptance.sitl_complete: All required condition/mode rows have valid external evidence and independent audit; normal static/contradiction missions succeed and adverse conditions satisfy their safety criterion; independent raw-path and execution-consequence audit must establish new reasoning actually used in principal nominal rows
acceptance.software_correctness: All scheduled rows accounted for, zero collisions/reserve violations/unsafe commands, every adverse condition exercised, positive static task completion; separate from SITL; default new reasoning must be called and execute through the independent gateway in nominal principal rows

calibration_status: Confirmation 861703..861708 is exposed and preserved negative. New engineering calibration: EKF2_ACC_NOISE=0.7 versus default0.35, keeping EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE=0.01, sensors/world noise, budgets and all measurement limits. Hypothesis: increase prediction uncertainty to improve GNSS correction of persistent vertical-velocity error. Must pass six fresh development episodes and independent audit before full development and a new confirmation 971809..971814. Exception recovery observes autopilot disarm after heartbeat cancellation but preserves the original failed outcome. No cognitive-learning claim.

priors.effects: Two declared synthetic unit displacements per horizontal action; no reward training
priors.power: Declared conservative simulated-charge prior, not fitted from flights; n=8 is the inherited model schema requirement, not eight measured samples

reasoning.consequences: Actual ordered proposal, unique matching send, accepted ACK, three distinct settled samples and arrival required for execution credit; terminal outcomes and unresolved actions retained. Only outcomes delivered in a confirmed subsequent actor reply count toward its causal history.
reasoning.default_path_gate: every principal nominal row must have reasoner_calls>0 and reasoner_executed>0; a plan_source string alone is insufficient
reasoning.effects: declared_nominal_prior; no synthetic acquisition receipts or trained-model claim
reasoning.graph_exclusion: unknown or not currently admitted; not an assertion that a wall exists
reasoning.independence: MissionAgent POWER/return/inspection plus independently replayed SAFE/gateway remain authoritative

information_gathering.actions: Existing canonical yaw-only INSPECT WSPs; no translation into unknown space
information_gathering.cost: All perception, probe decisions, execution, battery and logical work charged; second projection only for an otherwise-unresolved return step
information_gathering.evaluation: New development and reserved confirmation; no reclassification of earlier failures
information_gathering.evidence: Current path failure or blocked return neighbour, index, cumulative count, stationary prediction and independent reserve check
information_gathering.priority: POWER land/energy decisions and external SAFE/gateway stay authoritative; never clear a prior stop or energy-return latch
information_gathering.trigger: New planner has no path supported by the current frame, or a return step lacks fresh independent admission

reasoning.latency_boundary: default path projects once inside inherited MissionAgent; hook consumes already projected/registered frame only after POWER
reasoning.representation: echo5.grounding.Object/Scene and same_row/same_col relations on public admitted cells; requested target is not an observed marker

scope: New software and Gazebo/PX4 SITL episodes only; no HIL, hardware or flight certification
seed_separation: Development [seed, seed+cases-1] must not intersect its complete reserved confirmation interval; checked before worlds/processes and by auditors.

sitl.collision_measure: Swept horizontal 400 mm body envelope against generated 3 m obstacle boxes; private Gazebo pose timestamps; no contact-force claim
sitl.determinism: Pinned image, sources, generated world, config and physics seed; no promise of exact floating point replay
sitl.network: none; inherited MAVLink UDP port 14540 and Gazebo discovery exist only inside each container

private_pose_instrumentation.historical_poll_log: Preserved for original world-intervention records and diagnostics, not used as the dense pose stream
private_pose_instrumentation.method: Inherited Gazebo dynamic_pose callback, original pose timestamps, bounded queue, drained independent writer
private_pose_instrumentation.missing_samples: Any overflow, invalid pose, timestamp regression, incomplete writer or gap above truth_max_gap_ns invalidates the receipt; no interpolation
private_pose_instrumentation.separation: Private evaluator artifact only; never sent to actor or policy

software.audit_criteria: Independent evaluator-world consequences and POWER/SAFE/gateway reconstruction from each row trace, recalculated successes/costs/denominators, plus exact logical replay in a fresh process; independently check current-evidence path witnesses, action binding, confirmed gateway consequences, causal history, reasoning usage, and declared prior provenance
software.determinism: Same config gives identical logical rows; software ACKs, telemetry and consequences are explicitly synthetic
